user.title: FranklinWH aGate (local)
user.description: Local polling and control of the aGate over its Direct Connect socket (TCP 9000). Enter the aGate's LAN IP address.

modules.title: Optional modules
modules.description:
Detected on the aGate: {detected}.

Auto-detect uses this (or your FranklinWH account, if you turn on the cloud check). Choose Installed / Not installed to override. Entities for modules that aren't installed are not created.

data.cloud_check: Check modules with my FranklinWH account

data_description.cloud_check: Optional. Reads the accessory list from the FranklinWH cloud when the integration starts. Polling and control stay local.
data_description.cloud_password: Stored in Home Assistant and only used for the module check.

error.cloud_failed: Could not reach the FranklinWH cloud. Try again, or turn off the cloud check.
